company.description:
Kitekraft is involved in the design and development of flying wind turbines that generate electrical energy and electricity at a low cost. It flies in figure eights autonomously and generates electrical energy from the wind. The company's systems require ten times the materials of a conventional wind turbine while reaching higher altitudes with stronger and more consistent winds.

Kitekraft allows wind energy to be generated with less material than conventional wind turbines, lowering costs, and logistical effort, and being less visible.

productsAndServices.description: Tethered kites equipped with rotors that generate electrical energy by flying in controlled patterns, transmitting power via cables to a ground station.
productsAndServices.name: Flying Wind Turbines
